+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+"""Standalone vendored copy of ``copychunked`` from ``_pytest._py.path``.
+
+This module has no dependency on ``_pytest`` so it can be imported directly
+by file path without loading the pytest package.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+from typing import IO
+from typing import Protocol
+from typing import TypeVar
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_chunk_copy", "vendored_chunk_copy_variant"]
+
+
+class _Openable(Protocol):
+    def open(self, mode: str) -> IO[Any]: ...
+
+
+_DestT = TypeVar("_DestT", bound=_Openable)
+
+
+def vendored_chunk_copy(src, dest):
+    chunksize = 524288  # half a meg of bytes
+    fsrc = src.open("rb")
+    try:
+        fdest = dest.open("wb")
+        try:
+            while 1:
+                buf = fsrc.read(chunksize)
+                if not buf:
+                    break
+                fdest.write(buf)
+        finally:
+            fdest.close()
+    finally:
+        fsrc.close()
+
+
+def vendored_chunk_copy_variant(src: _Openable, dest: _DestT) -> _DestT:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_chunk_copy`, but return ``dest`` after copying."""
+    vendored_chunk_copy(src, dest)
+    return dest

@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+import importlib.util
+import io
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_chunk_copy.py"
+)
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "_standalone_wave6_chunk_copy_under_test", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+mod = _load_module()
+
+
+class TrackingStream(io.BytesIO):
+    def __init__(self, data: bytes = b"", fail_write: bool = False) -> None:
+        super().__init__(data)
+        self.fail_write = fail_write
+        self.was_closed = False
+        self.final_value = b""
+
+    def write(self, b: Any) -> int:
+        if self.fail_write:
+            raise OSError("write failed")
+        return super().write(b)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.final_value = self.getvalue()
+        self.was_closed = True
+        super().close()
+
+
+class FakePath:
+    def __init__(
+        self, stream: TrackingStream | None = None, error: bool = False
+    ) -> None:
+        self.stream = stream if stream is not None else TrackingStream()
+        self.error = error
+        self.modes: list[str] = []
+
+    def open(self, mode: str) -> TrackingStream:
+        self.modes.append(mode)
+        if self.error:
+            raise OSError("cannot open")
+        return self.stream
+
+
+COPIERS = [mod.vendored_chunk_copy, mod.vendored_chunk_copy_variant]
+
+
+def test_module_has_no_pytest_dependency() -> None:
+    source = MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "import _pytest" not in source
+    assert "from _pytest" not in source
+    assert "import pytest" not in source
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {"vendored_chunk_copy", "vendored_chunk_copy_variant"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("copier", COPIERS)
+def test_copy_multiple_chunks(copier: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+    data = bytes(range(256)) * 5000  # larger than one chunk
+    src = FakePath(TrackingStream(data))
+    dest = FakePath(TrackingStream())
+    copier(src, dest)
+    assert dest.stream.final_value == data
+    assert src.modes == ["rb"]
+    assert dest.modes == ["wb"]
+    assert src.stream.was_closed and dest.stream.was_closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("copier", COPIERS)
+def test_copy_empty(copier: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+    src = FakePath(TrackingStream(b""))
+    dest = FakePath(TrackingStream())
+    copier(src, dest)
+    assert dest.stream.final_value == b""
+    assert src.stream.was_closed and dest.stream.was_closed
+
+
+def test_unchanged_function_returns_none() -> None:
+    src = FakePath(TrackingStream(b"abc"))
+    dest = FakePath(TrackingStream())
+    assert mod.vendored_chunk_copy(src, dest) is None
+
+
+def test_variant_returns_dest() -> None:
+    src = FakePath(TrackingStream(b"abc"))
+    dest = FakePath(TrackingStream())
+    assert mod.vendored_chunk_copy_variant(src, dest) is dest
+    assert dest.stream.final_value == b"abc"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("copier", COPIERS)
+def test_dest_open_error_closes_src(copier: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+    src = FakePath(TrackingStream(b"abc"))
+    dest = FakePath(error=True)
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="cannot open"):
+        copier(src, dest)
+    assert src.stream.was_closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("copier", COPIERS)
+def test_src_open_error(copier: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+    src = FakePath(error=True)
+    dest = FakePath(TrackingStream())
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="cannot open"):
+        copier(src, dest)
+    assert dest.modes == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("copier", COPIERS)
+def test_write_error_closes_both(copier: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
+    src = FakePath(TrackingStream(b"abc"))
+    dest = FakePath(TrackingStream(fail_write=True))
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="write failed"):
+        copier(src, dest)
+    assert src.stream.was_closed and dest.stream.was_closed
+
+
+def test_real_files(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    src = tmp_path / "src.bin"
+    src.write_bytes(b"x" * 1_000_000)
+    dest = tmp_path / "dest.bin"
+    assert mod.vendored_chunk_copy_variant(src, dest) is dest
+    assert dest.read_bytes() == src.read_bytes()
+
+
+def test_import_does_not_load_pytest_package() -> None:
+    import subprocess
+
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys;"
+        f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(MODULE_PATH)!r});"
+        "m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m);"
+        "assert not any(n == '_pytest' or n.startswith('_pytest.') for n in sys.modules)"
+    )
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], check=True)
notes:
Copied copychunked verbatim as vendored_chunk_copy (no decorators/defaults to preserve, no supporting private names needed) into a standalone module, with vendored_chunk_copy_variant calling it and returning dest; tests load the module via spec_from_file_location using fake open()-exposing paths plus real tmp files, and verify pytest is not imported.
